svg.aria-label: Profile banner for Syed Saifullah Shah, Computer Science graduate of FAST-NUCES specialising in computer networking and security. Ascii-rendered portrait on the left. Terminal panel on the right lists role, education, focus, network and security protocols, AWS cloud services, a stack of Python, C/C++, Java, IPv4/IPv6, OSPF, BGP, VLAN, Cisco ASA, NAT/PAT, ACL, AWS EC2, AWS S3 and MongoDB, plus three selected projects and contact links. Links: github.com/saifullah-shah, linkedin.com/in/syed-saifullah-shah-9702a6154, tirmezi.17@gmail.com, +92 302 5733496.
